nodes.Name: registerLoadFromEmbeddedTZData
nodes.DocComment:
registerLoadFromEmbeddedTZData is called by the time/tzdata package,
if it is imported.

go:linkname registerLoadFromEmbeddedTZData

nodes.Name: loadFromEmbeddedTZData
nodes.DocComment:
loadFromEmbeddedTZData is used to load a specific tzdata file
from tzdata information embedded in the binary itself.
This is set when the time/tzdata package is imported,
via registerLoadFromEmbeddedTzdata.

nodes.Name: maxFileSize
nodes.DocComment:
maxFileSize is the max permitted size of files read by readFile.
As reference, the zoneinfo.zip distributed by Go is ~350 KB,
so 10MB is overkill.

nodes.Name: LoadLocationFromTZData
nodes.DocComment:
LoadLocationFromTZData returns a Location with the given name
initialized from the IANA Time Zone database-formatted data.
The data should be in the format of a standard IANA time zone file
(for example, the content of /etc/localtime on Unix systems).

Children.Name: if
Children.RawSource: z.name == name && z.offset == offset && z.isDST == isDST

nodes.Name: loadTzinfoFromDirOrZip
nodes.DocComment:
loadTzinfoFromDirOrZip returns the contents of the file with the given name
in dir. dir can either be an uncompressed zip file, or a directory.

nodes.Name: get4
nodes.DocComment: get4 returns the little-endian 32-bit value in b.

nodes.Name: get2
nodes.DocComment: get2 returns the little-endian 16-bit value in b.

nodes.Name: loadTzinfoFromZip
nodes.DocComment:
loadTzinfoFromZip returns the contents of the file with the given name
in the given uncompressed zip file.

Children.Name: if
Children.RawSource: err != nil || get4(buf) != zheader || get2(buf[8:]) != meth || get2(buf[26:]) != namelen || string(buf[30:30+namelen]) != name

nodes.Name: loadTzinfoFromTzdata
nodes.DocComment:
loadTzinfoFromTzdata returns the time zone information of the time zone
with the given name, from a tzdata database file as they are typically
found on android.

nodes.Name: loadTzinfo
nodes.DocComment:
loadTzinfo returns the time zone information of the time zone
with the given name, from a given source. A source may be a
timezone database directory, tzdata database file or an uncompressed
zip file, containing the contents of such a directory.

nodes.Name: loadLocation
nodes.DocComment:
loadLocation returns the Location with the given name from one of
the specified sources. See loadTzinfo for a list of supported sources.
The first timezone data matching the given name that is successfully loaded
and parsed is returned as a Location.

nodes.Name: readFile
nodes.DocComment:
readFile reads and returns the content of the named file.
It is a trivial implementation of os.ReadFile, reimplemented
here to avoid depending on io/ioutil or os.
It returns an error if name exceeds maxFileSize bytes.
